result:
A10 is done. All three verification commands pass clean.

## What I built

**`convex/falWebhook.ts`** — the `httpAction`, registered as `POST /fal/webhook` in `convex/http.ts`. Verification follows STUDIO-PLAN 4.3 exactly:
- `request.arrayBuffer()` is read *first*; the body is parsed only after the signature checks out
- SHA-256 over the raw bytes → `requestId\nuserId\ntimestamp\nhexSha256(rawBody)`
- signature hex-decoded, JWKS `x` base64url-decoded, Ed25519 via `crypto.subtle` — no new npm dependency
- ±300 s timestamp tolerance, all four headers mandatory, JWKS cached 24 h max

Post-verification the handler does one internal mutation and returns 200: job not found or not `running` → exit; `ERROR` → existing `studio.failJob` (failed → refund → refunded); `OK` → `done` + fal URL + scheduled `persistOutput`. File download stays out of the handler.

**`convex/falWebhookCore.ts`** — pure logic (repo convention), **`convex/falWebhook.test.ts`** — 27 tests.

## Verification
- `npx convex codegen` ✅ · `npm run lint` ✅ 0 errors (same 7 pre-existing warnings) · `npm run test` ✅ 31 files / 208 tests (was 30/181)
- I mutated the implementation five ways to prove the tests aren't vacuous — hashing re-serialized JSON, dropping the timestamp check, dropping the `status !== "running"` guard, dropping the header check, skipping signature verification. Every one was caught; original is 27/27 green.

## Two things for you in the morning

**1. Ed25519 is unverified on the live Convex runtime.** It works in vitest's `edge-runtime`, but confirming the real runtime would need a deploy, which the rules forbid. I did *not* write a BLOKADA because there's no error to report — the calls pass. Check it with `npx convex dev` before trusting this path; the fallback if Convex rejects it is `@noble/ed25519`, but that's your call, not mine.

**2. `persistOutput` is an empty stub** (A11 fills it), so a successful generation reaches `done` with a short-lived fal URL and nothing in Convex storage yet.

Also noted in the progress log: I added `generationJobs.falOutputUrl` (optional, no migration — A10 asks to save the URL and the A1 schema had nowhere to put it), and the stuck-job reaper from 4.4 doesn't exist yet, which the webhook leans on in two degenerate cases. Full decision list is in `docs/STUDIO-PROGRESS.md`.
